description: Campaign 024 frontend UX modernization is terminal/VALIDATED. Its packet is retained as historical ownership evidence and authorizes no new implementation work.

parallelPackets.objective: Implement the input/content kit primitives on the frozen token + Tappable/Button/Card contract.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Every listed primitive renders, honours tokens (no literals), exposes a11y role/name, meets the 44 dp contract, and has focused tests for behaviour that a plausible bug would break.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/components/ui

parallelPackets.objective: Implement the metric/progress kit primitives (rings, bars, animated numbers, stat blocks, screen header, segmented control, icon button).
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Primitives render without react-native-svg or new native deps, animate through the motion tokens, collapse under reduced motion, and pass focused tests.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/components/ui

parallelPackets.objective: Rebuild Home around a single hero (daily-workout goal + streak strip), a real level/XP meter, section headers with See-all, kit CTAs, skeletons and empty/error states.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Home renders one hero, one primary action, uniform section anatomy, and preserves every existing home-* testID; autobot warm-home still resolves.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app src/components/workout src/components/mastery src/components/spotlight

parallelPackets.objective: Modernize the Games library and Game detail: featured/recommended card, kit search + chips, adaptive multi-column grid, mastery-ring hero, personal-best row, ListRow session history.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Library adapts columns by breakpoint, search/filter use kit primitives, detail screen has one hero and one primary action, all games-*/game-detail-* testIDs preserved.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app src/components/discovery

parallelPackets.objective: Modernize the Progress suite: composite hero, readable charts (labels, zero states, identity colours), ListRows, kit segmented control window selector, a11y roles on every row and chart.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Charts carry axis/day labels and zero states, every row has a role and hint, charts expose textual summaries, dark mode has no hardcoded-colour artifacts, progress-* testIDs preserved.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app src/analytics

parallelPackets.objective: Modernize Profile, Rewards and Data management: identity hero, streak strip, distinct claimable/in-progress/locked treatments, cosmetic gallery, kit inputs/buttons, destructive-confirm styling.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Claimable rewards are visually distinct from in-progress and locked, identity hero present, all profile-*/rewards-*/data-* testIDs preserved, destructive actions unchanged in behaviour.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app src/components/settings

parallelPackets.objective: Modernize the Results screen (celebration → headline → metric row → single CTA, personal-best state) and fix the late-tap feedback/score mismatch in the three named games by resolving feedback from the authoritative round outcome.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Results renders the reference structure with a single primary action; each named game's tap feedback derives from the reducer-resolved outcome (test proving a post-deadline tap does not emit success feedback); results-* testIDs preserved.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app src/games/attention-odd-one-out src/games/attention-visual-search src/games/math-fast-math

parallelPackets.objective: Adopt the upgraded feedback primitives in the eight category canary games: fill+icon verdict (never colour alone), correct answer revealed alongside a wrong pick, animated score delta, reduced-motion gate, 44 dp targets.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Each canary game's answer surface marks verdicts with fill + icon, animates score changes, respects reduced motion, and keeps its scoring/reducer semantics byte-identical; existing game tests pass.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/games
